page.title: Udapt by iSafeNet: The Fitness Plan That Adapts Around You
page.description: Udapt is a private training and nutrition app for iPhone and Apple Watch: one adaptive Daily Plan that reads Apple Health each morning and adjusts today's training and food targets together.
page.lead: Udapt reads Apple Health (or a quick morning check-in) every day and adjusts today's training and today's food targets together, as one connected plan, with a plain-English reason for every change. No spreadsheets, no separate apps to reconcile.
features: Heart rate variability, resting heart rate and sleep from Apple Health, or a 5-question morning check-in if you don't wear your Watch to bed. Either way, you get a score and a plain reason why.
Training that eases off, not just logs
A rough night trims today's sets and caps effort automatically. A good run of days lets your program progress. You can always keep the original session, one tap.
Food targets that move with training

More carbs on training days, a little less on rest days, and the week's total stays the same. After two weeks of logging, your calorie target adapts to what your body actually does, not a generic formula.
Search thousands of foods, scan a barcode, or use on-device AI to log a meal from a photo or by describing it out loud. Nothing leaves your phone.
Flag a shoulder, knee or lower back you're being careful with, and Udapt automatically swaps exercises that load it for a like-for-like alternative that doesn't.
No ads, no third-party analytics. Health data stays in Apple Health; anything Udapt-only stays on your phone.
platforms: Today's readiness, training and food targets in one place, explained in plain English.
A full companion app, included: today's plan at a glance, sets logged with the Digital Crown, and a rest timer on your wrist.
Today's plan on the Home Screen and Lock Screen, and your rest timer live during a workout.
Ask for your readiness or log your usual breakfast, hands-free.
Swift 6, SwiftUI, HealthKit, WidgetKit, ActivityKit, App Intents, Foundation Models (on-device AI), Speech and StoreKit 2.
page.pricing: Udapt is a subscription: £6.99/month or £39.99/year, with a 7-day free trial on both plans.
page.good_to_know: Udapt is a wellness tool, not a medical device, and doesn't diagnose or treat anything. Always talk to your doctor about what's safe for you, especially around injuries.
page.learn_more: Udapt has its own website, with full pricing, privacy and support information.
